tools.name: facebook_download_links
tools.description: Get direct download links for a public Facebook video, reel, watch link, share link or photo post: SD and HD MP4 with audio, separate video/audio tracks, thumbnail, title and duration.

tools.name: tiktok_download_links
tools.description: Get no-watermark MP4 links (HD original quality and SD, with file sizes), every image of a photo post or slideshow, the music track, cover image, title and author for a public TikTok post.

tools.name: pinterest_download_links
tools.description: Get download links for the videos, images and GIFs of a public Pinterest pin or Idea Pin (pinterest.com or pin.it short links).

tools.name: instagram_download_links
tools.description: Get download links for a public Instagram post, reel or carousel: MP4 with audio, higher-resolution video and audio tracks, full-size images in carousel order, author and caption.

tools.name: read_webpage
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (or plain text), with title, description, author, publish date and language. Pages that need JavaScript are rendered automatically. Use it to read articles, docs, blog posts and product pages.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and get the top results (title, URL, snippet). Set read (1-5) to also get the full text of the top results as Markdown, so you can answer from the pages themselves. Use it for current events, facts you are unsure about, documentation and anything after your training data.

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Find recent news articles about a topic: headline, source, publish time, snippet and URL. Combine with read_webpage to read an article in full.

tools.name: shopify_products
tools.description: List or search the products of any Shopify store: title, URL, vendor, type, price range, availability and variants. Give a product URL to get that product with per-variant stock when the store shows it.

tools.name: instagram_profile
tools.description: Get a public Instagram profile: full name, bio, verified badge, follower, following and post counts, profile picture and the 12 most recent posts (link, type, caption, thumbnail).

tools.name: instagram_post_info
tools.description: Get the details of a public Instagram post or reel: publish date, likes, comment count, views, caption, hashtags, mentions, location, tagged users, owner, media links and the comments shown publicly on the page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links, instagram_download_links, read_webpage, web_search, news_search, shopify_products, instagram_profile, instagram_post_info · Private data: tiktok_download_links · Public sink: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links, instagram_download_links, read_webpage, news_search, instagram_profile, instagram_post_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links, instagram_download_links, read_webpage, web_search, news_search, shopify_products, instagram_profile, instagram_post_info · Private data: tiktok_download_links · Public sink: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links, instagram_download_links, read_webpage, news_search, instagram_profile, instagram_post_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
